name: Da Good Vibes Eats
notes: 5 photos, all clearly legible. Photos 1-3 show 3 different printed menu-board revisions of this food truck's menu with the same core dishes but some conflicting prices/names over time (e.g. Da Good Vibes Nachos $18/$16/$18, Crispy Tofu Sliders $15/$14/$15, Truffle Fries $7 vs $8) -- the majority/most legible price was used per item and conflicts are noted per-dish below. Da Pinoy Chili Dog appears with two different prices and meat descriptions across boards with no majority, so its price is omitted and both variants are described. Rib Eye Bistec (photo 1) and Bistek & Frites (photo 3) may be the same dish renamed/re-plated but have different prices/descriptions on their respective boards, so both are kept as separate entries. Several items were marked 'N/A' and covered with blue tape (discontinued) and were excluded. Photos 4-5 are promotional vinyl-record-style plate photos with no pricing, used only to confirm dish names.
